evidence.why: Declares the static cookie and establishes function linkage, return types, parameter lists, and the helper's capacity calculation.

facts.rationale: Preserves the supported source organization while removing the unsupported claim that the cookie is allocated in .sbss. External linkage is distinct from a public API.
facts.value: Dolphin OS serial-I/O translation unit containing a file-local static unsigned-long enable cookie, three external-linkage integer-status UART operations (InitializeUART, ReadUARTN, and WriteUARTN), and a private integer-valued queue-capacity helper. InitializeUART and ReadUARTN have legacy empty parameter lists; WriteUARTN accepts void* buf and u32 len. Source declarations do not establish compiled section placement.
